chunk_size.description: Target chunk size in characters (UTF-8 code points), not whitespace tokens — see D-053. For recursive/markdown this is the leaf chunk size; for parent_child this is the child chunk size.

chunk_overlap.description: Overlap between consecutive chunks, in characters (same unit as chunk_size). Must be smaller than chunk_size.

parent_chunk_size.description: Parent chunk size for parent_child strategy, in characters (same unit as chunk_size). Default keeps roughly the previous 4:1 parent:child ratio (D-053).

minimum_size.description: Minimum chunk size in characters. A trailing recursive-split chunk shorter than this is merged into the previous chunk instead of being stored on its own (04-knowledge-platform.md §2.5 Recursive). Added contract-first alongside the chunking strategy implementation — see D-053.

metadata_fields.description: Document metadata fields to index for filtering
